Yup what the title says, the point of this is if you’ve had any skills/ideas but didn’t execute it try it out due to feeling alone or boredom because to be honest in this day and age everyone is chasing highs and doomscrolling. People have less self belief in themselves and get crowded with a lot of internet problems and useless information.

I made this community so you can live your life as it is but when you clock in, you can have a group of people to help push you and help each other out with skillsets that you may have experience with, languages, etc.

Anyone is free to enter but I would recommended you to join if you have a burning passion to change your life and future, feel like the world doesn’t get you and doesn’t have huge goals that you might have.

Send me a dm for the link, I just made it and hopefully we can go a long way!

Thanks you for reading and I hope to see you in!
